candidates.change_summary: Change the final return statement from `return true;` to `return false;` so a successful call returns false instead of true.
Change the return value from true to false, making every successful call observable as returning false instead of true.
Delete the revert on failed sub-call, so failures no longer revert and transfer returns true even when a transferFrom call fails.
Start the loop at i = 1 instead of 0, skipping the first recipient so its transfer is never performed and any call with one recipient reverts on the out-of-bounds access.
Move the require(_tos.length > 0) statement to after the loop, so empty input arrays are no longer rejected and transfer returns true without performing any sub-calls.
Change the return statement from 'return true;' to 'return false;'.
Replace the revert() on call failure with no-op logic so failed transferFrom calls no longer revert and transfer returns true.
Change the loop index start from 0 to 1 so the first recipient is never processed, changing which calls succeed or revert.
Replace v[i] with v[0] in the transferFrom call so every recipient uses the first amount, changing success/failure outcomes.
Discard the low-level call result so transfer never reverts on a failed transferFrom and always returns true.

Ignore the success flag of the transferFrom call so a failing call no longer reverts.
